lede.zh: 同一单卡部署与 512/256 请求形状下，不同到达过程给出不同 TTFT P99；guidellm poisson 的 427 ms 阈值边界为 2.788 req/s。
lede.en: With the same single-card deployment and 512/256 request, different arrival processes produce different TTFT P99; the guidellm poisson boundary at a 427 ms threshold is 2.788 req/s.

snapshot.zh: 512 输入 / 256 输出 · 恒定与泊松到达 · 闭环对照
snapshot.en: 512 input / 256 output · constant and Poisson arrivals · closed-loop controls

heading.zh: 容量结果必须写清请求如何到达
heading.en: Capacity results must state how requests arrive

intro.zh: 闭环满载吞吐、固定时长 sweep 和开环泊松到达测量的是不同现象。闭环生成器会随响应时间变长自动降低新请求发出速率，可能掩盖过载。
intro.en: Closed-loop saturation, fixed-duration sweeps, and open-loop Poisson arrivals measure different behaviors. A closed-loop generator reduces offered load as response time grows and can hide overload.

note.zh: 427 ms P99 下恒定到达与真泊松的 safe_rps 是下界；只有 guidellm poisson 越过阈值并经三次复测确认。主 200 ms P99 在最低档已不达标，未测出精确 safe_rps。
note.en: At 427 ms P99, constant and true-Poisson safe_rps are lower bounds; only guidellm poisson crossed the threshold and was confirmed in three repeats. The primary 200 ms P99 failed at the lowest rate, so exact safe_rps was not measured.

heading.zh: 请求成团度改变观测到的延迟

intro.zh: 固定 512 输入 / 256 输出，在同一 Qwen3-8B BF16 单卡部署上测试恒定到达、真泊松及 guidellm 标称 poisson。
intro.en: Constant, true-Poisson, and guidellm nominal-poisson arrivals were tested with fixed 512 input / 256 output on one Qwen3-8B BF16 deployment.

notes.zh: 不同到达过程的 P99 不能直接当作容量排名；需同时看 safe_rps 阈值和离散指数。
notes.en: P99 across arrival processes is not a direct capacity ranking; interpret it with the safe_rps threshold and dispersion index.

title.zh: λ≈6 req/s 时的 TTFT P99

hint.zh: 三种到达过程的请求间隔分布不同。
hint.en: The request-interval distributions differ across the three arrival processes.

heading.zh: 不要把闭环吞吐当成开放环容量
heading.en: Do not treat closed-loop throughput as open-loop capacity

intro.zh: 同一部署的闭环最大吞吐为 8.11 req/s；此值表示完成速率，不是可持续到达率。guideLLM 30 秒/档和 300 秒/档 sweep 得到的最高达标点也不同。
intro.en: The same deployment reaches 8.11 req/s maximum closed-loop throughput; this is a completion rate, not a sustainable arrival rate. GuideLLM 30-second and 300-second steps also yield different highest passing points.

notes.zh: λ=12 档有 23.5% 请求未完成，幸存请求的延迟分位数存在偏差，不用作服务体验结论。
notes.en: At λ=12, 23.5% of requests did not complete; survivor latency percentiles are biased and are not used as service-experience conclusions.

title.zh: 三种容量读数回答不同问题
title.en: Three capacity readings answer different questions

hint.zh: 该比较中的 SLO 和 sweep 时长不同；仅展示各自读数。
hint.en: SLO and sweep duration differ; values are shown in their original contexts.

methodIntro.zh: 保持同一服务部署与请求形状，改变到达过程、压测工具及每档测试时长。容量结论必须绑定 SLO、到达模型和档位时长。
methodIntro.en: The serving deployment and request profile are held constant while arrival process, load tool, and step duration vary. Capacity conclusions must include SLO, arrival model, and step duration.

methodNotes.zh: 主阈值 TTFT P99 ≤ 200 ms 在最低测试档已失败，因此 safe_rps 只能限定为低于该档，无法给出精确边界。
methodNotes.en: The primary TTFT P99 ≤ 200 ms threshold failed at the lowest tested rate, so safe_rps is bounded below that step and has no exact measured boundary.

methodNotes.zh: 恒定与真泊松到达在 427 ms P99 下未越阈，仅给出下界；不能拿下界与 2.788 req/s 直接计算比例。
methodNotes.en: Constant and true-Poisson arrivals did not cross the 427 ms P99 threshold, so only lower bounds are available; do not divide those bounds by 2.788 req/s.

methodNotes.zh: 该报告评估压测方法对同一权重结果的影响，不比较模型权重。
methodNotes.en: This report studies how load-generation methods affect measurements for one checkpoint; it does not compare model checkpoints.
